offers.title: Morning Rush
offers.headline: Any coffee + any pastry for $6
offers.description: Walk in before 10 am and pair any handcrafted coffee with any pastry from the counter for a flat six dollars. No voucher needed, just ask at the till.
terms: Valid Monday to Friday, 7 am to 10 am
One pastry and one coffee per person per visit
Cannot be combined with the Tenth Cup Free reward

offers.title: Baker's Dozen
offers.headline: Buy 12 cookies, take 13
offers.description: Order any twelve cookies, mixed however you like, and the thirteenth is on the house. Boxed in our kraft gift box at no extra charge.
terms: Available in store and by phone order

offers.title: Celebration Cakes
offers.headline: 15% off custom cakes ordered 7 days ahead
offers.description: Plan ahead and save. Any custom celebration cake ordered at least a week in advance takes fifteen percent off, including the hand-piped message and candles.
terms: Applies to 1 kg cakes and larger
Design subject to confirmation with our decorator

offers.title: End of Day Bread
offers.headline: Half price on all loaves after 6 pm
offers.description: We bake fresh every morning and refuse to sell day-old bread as fresh, so everything left on the shelf after six goes out at half price. First come, first served.

offers.title: Tenth Cup Free
offers.headline: Collect nine stamps, the tenth drink is free
offers.description: Every hot or cold drink earns a stamp on your Bakerz Bite card. Nine stamps and your tenth is free, whatever you choose, including the Belgian hot chocolate.
terms: Physical card issued free at the counter
Free drink may be any item from the beverage menu

offers.title: Weekend Family Box
offers.headline: Four pastries, a loaf and four drinks for $29
offers.description: Saturday and Sunday only. Pick any four pastries, any loaf from the bread shelf and four drinks, and we will box the lot for twenty-nine dollars.
terms: Choice of any four pastries and any one loaf
Drinks include hot and iced options
